book.title: Rig Veda
book.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
book.license: Public domain translation (Griffith, 1896); transcription from Wikisource. Griffith’s commentary and notes are not included.
book.notes: Complete translation in Griffith’s arrangement: ten Maṇḍalas, one chapter per hymn, one verse per stanza. The Sanskrit text and Griffith’s commentary are not included. Hymn 1.179, which the 1896 edition prints only as an appendix note, is absent.

verses.translation: I laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The Hotar, lavishest of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers: He shall bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Angiras, is indeed thy truth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer Bringing thee reverence, we come;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: BEAUTIFUL Vayu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared: Drink of them, hearken to our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify Thee, Vayu, with their hymns of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vayu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper, Far-spreading for the Soma draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: These, Indra-Vayu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties' sake: The drops are yearning for you both.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vayu and Indra, rich in spoil So come ye swiftly hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vayu and Indra, come to what the Soma. presser hath prepared: Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mitra and Varuna, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law, Have ye obtained your might power.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuna, wide dominion, strong by birth, Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: YE Asvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands, Accept the sacrificial food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Asvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise, Accept our songs with mighty thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Nasatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass: Come ye whose paths are red with flame.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers, Of the libation-pouring priest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers. In our libation take delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Visvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Visvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught, As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Visvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile, Bearers, accept the sacred draught
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarasvati desire, With eager love, our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer o all gracious thought, Sarasvati accept our rite
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sarasvati, the mighty flood,--she with be light illuminates, She brightens every pious thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Satakratu, drankest this and wast the Vrtras' slayer; thou Helpest the warrior in the fray.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We strengthen, Satakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice, yea, to this Indra sing your song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: May he come nigh us with his strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra sing your song.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, Strong Indra, for preëminence.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Satakratu, and our lauds So strengthen thee the songs we sing.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed The lights are shining in the sky.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial names.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm, Foundest the kine even in the cave.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The Ruler irresistible:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others', may he be.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may We conquer our embattled foes.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer: Wide as the heaven extends his power
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him The gladdening, omnific God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of' our wish, For power supreme is only thine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee. The priests have raised thee up on high, O Satakratu, like a pole.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task, Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud. Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives, That Sakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might. For Indra, he is Sakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee. Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood. Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry. Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra, Son of Kusika, drink our libation with delight. Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee: Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear. We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail, When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee. Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The wily Susna, Indra! thou o'er-threwest with thy wondrous powers. The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might, Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage: Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up Our enemies whom fiends protect.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears The gift: the ladle is his mouth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true, The God who driveth grief away.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts, Worshippeth thee the messenger.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods, O Purifier, favour him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us, And food, with heroes for our sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods, Show pleasure in this laud of ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts. Worship them, Purifier, Priest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today. Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dear Narasamsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods: Manu appointed thee as Priest.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due, Where the Immortal is beheld.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, For sacrifice this day and now.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass At this our solemn sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue, To celebrate this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring delight, Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Tvastar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will: May he be ours and curs alone.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods, And let the giver be renowned.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Svaha pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house: Thither I call the Deities.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs. With all these Gods; and worship them.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Kanvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise Agni, come hither with the Gods;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pusan, Bhaga, Adityas, and the Marut host.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate, The meath-drops resting in the cup.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The sons of Kanva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass, With offerings and all things prepared.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil, Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames: Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue The meath in solemn sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring All Gods awaking with the dawn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vayu, and Mitra's splendours, drink, Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite: Hallow thou this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones: With those bring hitherward the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Rtu; let the cheering drops Sink deep within, which settle there.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Rtu; sanctify The rite, for ye give precious gifts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Nestar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Rtu drink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down: Surround them, and with Rtu drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink Soma after the Rtus, from the Brahmana's bounty: undissolved, O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mitra, Varuna, ye whose ways are firm--a Power that none deceives--, With Rtu ye have reached the rite.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite, In sacrifices praise the God.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned. These things we gain, among the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He with the Rtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Nestar's bowl. Haste, give your offering, and depart.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Rtus, be A Giver bountiful to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Drink ye the meath, O Asvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who with Rtus accept the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Rtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice: Worship the Gods for the pious man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught-- Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring Indra upon his easiest car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice, Indra to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to the draught we pour We call thee when the juice is shed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee Drink of it like a stag athirst.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent: Then drink the Soma juice expressed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vrtra-slayer, comes, To drink the Soma for delight.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fulfil, O Satakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine: With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuna; may they Both favour one of us like me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call Of every singer such as I.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuna, with wealth: Fain would we have you nearest us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence Of you who give strength bounteously.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra and Varuna, among givers of thousands, meet for praise, Are Powers who merit highest laud.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up Enough and still to spare, be ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra-Varuna, on you for wealth in many a form I call: Still keep ye us victorious.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra-Varuna, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves, Give us at once your sheltering help.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Indra-Varuna, to you may fair praise which I offer come, Joint eulogy which ye dignify.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O BRAHMANAPSATI, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kaksivan Ausija.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,--may he be with us still.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us Preserve us, Brahmanaspati.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ne'er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmanaspati, And Soma graciously inspire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Do, thou, O Brahmanaspati, and Indra, Soma, Daksina, Preserve that mortal from distress.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He without whom no sacrifice, e'en of the wise man, prospers; he Stirs up the series of thoughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice: Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I have seen Narasamsa, him most resolute, most widely famed, As 'twere the Household Priest of heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one: O Agni, with the Maruts come:
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes': O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might O Agni, with those Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly Was made by singers with their lips.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word, Attained by works to sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They for the two Nasatyas wrought a light car moving every way: They formed a nectar-yielding cow.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Rbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made Their Sire and Mother young again.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt, With the Adityas, with the Kings.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvastar's hand-- Four ladles have ye made thereof.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves, A share in sacrifice with Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise: Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites: Sing praise to them in sacred songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fame Of Mitra, to the Soma-draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here: Indra and Agni, come to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends: Childless be the devouring ones.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious view Indra and Agni, send us bliss.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WAKEN the Asvin Pair who yoke their car at early morn: may they Approach to drink this Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call the Asvins Twain, the Gods borne in a noble car, the best Of charioteers, who reach the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Dropping with honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: As ye go thither in your car, not far, O Asvins, is the home Of him who offers Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For my protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar. He knoweth, as a God, the place.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That he may send us succour, praise the Waters' Offspring Savitar: Fain are we for his holy ways.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call on him, distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come hither, friends, and seat yourselves Savitar, to be praised by us, Giving good gifts, is beautiful.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, hither bring to us the willing Spouses of the Gods, And Tvastar, to the Soma draught.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Most youthful Agni, hither bring their Spouses, Hotra, Bharati, Varutri, Dhisana, for aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Spouses of Heroes, Goddesses, with whole wings may they come to us With great protection and with aid.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indrani, Varunani, and Agnayi hither I invite, For weal, to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, bedew for us our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Their water rich with fatness, there in the Gandharva's steadfast place, The singers taste through sacred songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thornless be thou, O Earth, spread wide before us for a dwelling-place: Vouchsafe us shelter broad and sure.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Gods be gracious unto us even from the place whence Visnu strode Through the seven regions of the earth!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through all this world strode Visnu; thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Visnu, the Guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps; thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Look ye on Visnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Visnu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This, Vishnu's station most sublime, the singers, ever vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: STRONG are the Somas; come thou nigh; these juices have been mixt with milk: Drink, Vayu, the presented draughts.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Both Deities who touch the heaven, Indra and Vayu we invoke To drink of this our soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The singers' for their aid, invoke Indra and Vayu, swift as mind, The thousand-eyed, the Lords of thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Mitra and Varuna, renowned as Gods of consecrated might, We call to drink the Soma juice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuna.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Let Varuna be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids Both make us rich exceedingly.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Indra, by Maruts girt, we call to drink the Soma juice: may he Sate him in union with his troop.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Gods, Marut hosts whom Indra leads, distributers of Pusan's gifts, Hearken ye all unto my cry.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With conquering Indra for ally, strike Vrtra down, ye bounteous Gods Let not the wicked master us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We call the Universal Gods, and Maruts to the Soma draught, For passing strong are Prsni's Sons.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fierce comes the Maruts' thundering voice, like that of conquerors, when ye go Forward to victory, O Men.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Born of the laughing lightning. may the Maruts guard us everywhere May they be gracious unto Us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like some lost animal, drive to us, bright Pusan, him who bears up heaven, Resting on many-coloured grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Pusan the Bright has found the King, concealed and hidden in a cave, Who rests on grass of many hues.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And may he. duly bring to me the six bound closely, through these drops, As one who ploughs with steers brings corn.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Along their paths the Mothers go, Sisters of priestly ministrants, Mingling their sweetness with the milk.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May Waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed forth this sacrifice of ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I call the Waters, Goddesses, wherein our cattle quench their thirst; Oblations to the Streams be given.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Amrit is in the Waters in the Waters there is healing balm Be swift, ye Gods, to give them praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Within the Waters--Soma thus hath told me--dwell all balms that heal, And Agni, he who blesseth all. The Waters hold all medicines.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm, So that I long may see the Sun.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought. If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come: O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Fill me with splendour, Agni; give offspring and length of days; the Gods Shall know me even as I am, and Indra with the Rsis, know.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHO now is he, what God among Immortals, of whose auspicious name we may bethink us? Who shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni the God the first among the Immortals,--of his auspicious name let us bethink us. He shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To thee, O Savitar, the Lord of precious things, who helpest us Continually, for our share we come-
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Wealth, highly lauded ere reproach hath fallen on it, which is laid, Free from all hatred, in thy hands
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Through thy protection may we come to even the height of affluence Which Bhaga hath dealt out to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ne'er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit; Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Varuna, King, of hallowed might, sustaineth erect the Tree's stem in the baseless region. Its rays, whose root is high above, stream downward. Deep may they sink within us, and be hidden.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: King Varuna hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate'er afflicts the spirit.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: A hundred balms are thine, O King, a thousand; deep and wide-reaching also be thy favours. Far from us, far away drive thou Destruction. Put from us e'en the sin we have committed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whither by day depart the constellations that shine at night, set high in heaven above us? Varuna's holy laws remain unweakened, and through the night the Moon moves on in splendor
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I ask this of thee with my prayer adoring; thy worshipper craves this with his oblation. Varuna, stay thou here and be not angry; steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Nightly and daily this one thing they tell me, this too the thought of mine own heart repeateth. May he to whom prayed fettered Sunahsepa, may he the Sovran Varuna release us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Bound to three pillars captured Sunahsepa thus to the Aditya made his supplication. Him may the Sovran Varuna deliver, wise, ne'er deceived, loosen the bonds that bind him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With bending down, oblations, sacrifices, O Varuna, we deprecate thine anger: Wise Asura, thou King of wide dominion, loosen the bonds of sins by us committed.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Loosen the bonds, O Varuna, that hold me, loosen the bonds above, between, and under. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Aditya.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WHATEVER law of thine, O God, O Varuna, as we are men, Day after day we violate.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: give us not as a prey to death, to be destroyed by thee in wrath, To thy fierce anger when displeased.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To gain thy mercy, Varuna, with hymns we bind thy heart, as binds The charioteer his tethered horse.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: They flee from me dispirited, bent only on obtaining wealths As to their nests the birds of air.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When shall we bring, to be appeased, the Hero, Lord of warrior might, Him, the far-seeing Varuna?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This, this with joy they both accept in common: never do they fail The ever-faithful worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He knows the path of birds that fly through heaven, and, Sovran of the sea, He knows the ships that are thereon.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: True to his holy law, he knows the twelve moons with their progeny: He knows the moon of later birth.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He knows the pathway of the wind, the spreading, high, and mighty wind: He knows the Gods who dwell above.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Varuna, true to holy law, sits down among his people; he, Most wise, sits there to govern all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: From thence percerving he beholds all wondrous things, both what hath been, And what hereafter will be done.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May that Aditya, very wise, make fair paths for us all our days: May he prolong our lives for us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Varuna, wearing golden mail, hath clad him in a shining robe. His spies are seated found about.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The God whom enemies threaten not, nor those who tyrannize o'er men, Nor those whose minds are bent on wrong.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: He who gives glory to mankind, not glory that is incomplete, To our own bodies giving it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Yearning for the wide-seeing One, my thoughts move onward unto him, As kine unto their pastures move.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Once more together let us speak, because my meath is brought: priest-like Thou eatest what is dear to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Now saw I him whom all may see, I saw his car above the earth: He hath accepted these my songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Varuna, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day Longing for help I cried to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, O wise God, art Lord of all, thou art the King of earth and heaven Hear, as thou goest on thy way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Release us from the upper bond, untie the bond between, and loose The bonds below, that I may live.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O WORTHY of oblation, Lord of prospering powers, assume thy robes, And offer this our sacrifice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Sit ever to be chosen, as our Priest, most youthful, through our hymns, O Agni, through our heavenly word.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For here a Father for his son, Kinsman for kinsman worshippeth, And Friend, choice-worthy, for his friend.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Here let the foe-destroyers sit, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Like men, upon our sacred grass.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O ancient Herald, be thou glad in this our rite and fellowship: Hearken thou well to these our songs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Whate'er in this perpetual course we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered up in thee
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he be our dear household Lord, Priest, pleasant and, choice-worthy may We, with bright fires, be dear to him.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: The Gods, adored with brilliant fires. have granted precious wealth to us So, with bright fires, we pray to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: And, O Immortal One, so may the eulogies of mortal men Belong to us and thee alike.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O Son of Strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WITH worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of sacred rites.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore Protect us from the sinful man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods, And this our newest song of praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below, A share of strength that is between.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou Swift streamest to the worshipper.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One: Nay, very glorious power is his.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight, And with the singers win the spoil.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him Adorable in every house.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright, Urge us to strength and holy thought.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder! Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: THERE where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work, Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee, Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements, Like two bay horses champing herbs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour, and on the ox-hide set the dregs.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be, Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course! Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine In thousands, O most wealthy One.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: WE seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts Flow, even as down a depth, to him;
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room Within his belly, like the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest too for this our prayer.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness Be his who sings the laud to thee.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight In others too let us agree.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all precious gifts, O Friend, Kind God to those who sing thy praise.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames And of our Soma-drinking friends.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act To aid each wish as we desire.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought, Bold One, the axle of the car.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: That, Satakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Come, Asvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine, And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts, Travels, O Asvins, in the sea.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep, The other round the sky revolves.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou? To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away, Red-hued and like a dappled mare.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings, And send thou riches down to us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Angiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods' auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Angiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods. Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: To Matarisvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvan through thy noble inward power. Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni thou madest heaven to thunder for mankind; thou, yet more pious, for pious Pururavas. When thou art rapidly freed from thy parents, first eastward they bear thee round, and, after, to the west.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thou, Agni, art a Bull who makes our store increase, to be invoked by him who lifts the ladle up. Well knowing the oblation with the hallowing word, uniting all who live, thou lightenest first our folk
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, thou savest in the synod when pursued e'en him, farseeing One! who walks in evil ways. Thou, when the heroes fight for spoil which men rush, round, slayest in war the many by the hands of few.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: For glory, Agni, day by day, thou liftest up the mortal man to highest immortality, Even thou who yearning for both races givest them great bliss, and to the prince grantest abundant food.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O Agni, highly lauded, make our singer famous that he may win us store of riches: May we improve the rite with new performance. O Earth and Heaven, with all the Gods, protect us.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: O blameless Agni lying in thy Parents' lap, a God among the Gods, be watchful for our good. Former of bodies, be the singer's Providence: all good things hast thou sown for him, auspicious One!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, thou art our Providence, our Father thou: we are thy brethren and thou art our spring of life. In thee, rich in good heroes, guard of high decrees, meet hundred, thousand treasures, O infallible!
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Thee, Agni, have the Gods made the first living One for living man, Lord of the house of Nahusa. Ila they made the teacher of the sons of men, what time a Son was born to the father of my race.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard of our seed art thou, aiding our cows to bear, incessantly protecting in thy holy way.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary

verses.translation: Agni, thou art a guard close to the pious man; kindled art thou, four-eyed! for him who is unarmed. With fond heart thou acceptest e'en the poor man's prayer, when he hath brought his gift to gain security.
verses.translationName: The Hymns of the Rigveda, translated with a popular commentary
